title: C2 confirmation prereg input

frozen_precursor_lag.selected_lag_from_artifact: No single-lag field is selected in C2_SELECTED_CANDIDATE.json; selection is feature-level under the frozen 3-band contract.
frozen_precursor_lag.note: bands are decisions relative to the outcome step t; all are strictly before t

primary_outcome_opportunity_definition.window_unit_requirement: the candidate must exist at the exact temporal unit a future handoff can consume
primary_outcome_opportunity_definition.score_stratum_rule: the effect must survive WITHIN at least one score stratum that meets the support minimum, not only pooled

confirmation_requirements_exact_from_fro.stage_2_data_source_rule: existing G0 discovery trajectories only; no fresh confirmation seed block consumed
confirmation_requirements_exact_from_fro.selection_rule: eligible: only candidates passing EVERY criterion above
confirmation_requirements_exact_from_fro.3_replication: same effect direction across all 3 established G0-V5 policies
confirmation_requirements_exact_from_fro.5_uncertainty: episode-clustered bootstrap CI excludes zero in >= 2 of 3 policies

7_headroom.definition: headroom = 1 - baseline_success, where baseline_success is natural frozen-G0 success in the exact candidate window

8_actionability.requirement: at onset BLUE must have >= 2 legal continuations that could affect the outcome
8_actionability.operational_proxy: the free teammate can contest at least as quickly as the nearest red that is able to tag now, i.e. intervention_margin = nearest_ready_defender_distance - mate_distance >= 0

9_non_mechanical_non_circular_lag_decay_.rule: the effect must be present with the correct direction in the EARLIEST band (t-30..t-20), not only in the latest

9_non_mechanical_non_circular_score_conf.rule: the effect must survive WITHIN at least one score stratum that meets the support minimum, not only pooled

immutability: No criterion, threshold, lag band, or ranking rule above may change after the Stage 2 audit produces numbers.
No runner-up substitution using confirmation data

post_confirmation_decision_rule.pass: Use this block as the foundation for O2 preregistration and proceed to O2 pipeline.
